notes.title: Update v1.2.0
notes.notes: [h3]WHAT'S IN THIS UPDATE[/h3][p][/p][p]In this BIG new update, I've focused on improving gameplay variety and fun factor! Version 1.2.0 is available for download now and builds upon the previous cumulative updates.[/p][p][/p][p]At the top of my to-do list was to make enemy AI more varied and interesting. With that in mind, multiple new attacks, behaviours, and animations have been added:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The Brute (large guy) now has a ranged attack where he stomps the ground to create a devastating ground-based projectile (pro tip: jump or roll out of the way!)[/p][/*][*][p]The Vixen (female enemy) also has a new ranged attack where she blows a deadly kiss towards you--I'll let you experience that for yourselves ;-)[/p][/*][*][p]The Goon (smaller guy) has been made smarter and angrier; if you run him around he'll likely go into a rage![/p][/*][*][p]Almost all arena battles have been updated to take advantage of all these additions and tweaks.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor tweaks and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check out the 3 screenshots below for a sneak peek at the new enemy AI in action.[/p][p][/p][h3]WHAT'S ON THE HORIZON[/h3][p][/p][p]Aside from gameplay updates and enhancements, I'm committed to adding more content to the core game. I've mapped out a plan for the next few months, and with you support, hope to deliver more cool DLC and a new "Challenges" game mode! To [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3343320/view/512965256196130025"]see the roadmap, check out the full post here[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support. Enjoy![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349548/c26975f8546c2c015b114a3aaaca46ac7b856a1a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349548/0b87028d4d2af493de8aa80bd7a4fe258eae4361.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349548/598bd51fdbf2580f4470751a3595640ec69b8700.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Lustborn Roadmap Q3-Q4 2025
notes.notes: [p]If you checked out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3343320/view/512965256196129059"]latest updates in v1.2.0[/url], you'll know that changes and updates to Lustborn are coming fast and furious.[/p][p][/p][p]In this post, I want to outline some of the future updates that will come in the form of regular updates and optional DLCs. The major highlight coming in Q4 is the new "Challenges" game mode, but don't sleep on the upcoming outfit pack or the enemy/weapon additions![/p][p][/p][p]If you have any thoughts about this or the latest update, please feel free to comment. I'd love to hear from you. Cheers![/p][p][/p][p]So, here's a detailed breakdown:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349548/2cca7f3a424f440a09208846fa5a16690966bf8f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update v1.1.1
notes.notes:
[p]Update v1.1.1 of Lustborn is live. I've been noting player feedback loud and clear since launch a few weeks ago, and I'm committed to improving and adding to the game to make it the best experience it can be!

Check out the list of changes below for details:[/p][list][*][p]New enemy type: the Skull! This one almost made it into the launch version but wasn't quite as refined as I wanted--but now it is completed. This enemy provides additional challenge and variety that I think many of you will appreciate. You can now find him scattered through the arena shootouts.[/p][/*][*][p]New checkpoints: several new checkpoints have been added to increase auto-save frequency in some areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved game structure: I'm planning to add many more free DLC packs in the coming weeks and months, and this change "under the hood" will allow the game to support this much better. Bottom line: expect more DLC![/p][/*][*][p]Other minor visual and bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your support. Enjoy![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349548/8b039dbac91e9497627d34e9e587f0ef1e765f95.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Lustborn Demo is Now Live for Next Fest
notes.notes:
[b]The time has come to jump into a uniquely sexy action-adventure in LUSTBORN![/b]

Lustborn is a solo passion project that I am extremely happy to be able to share with you. In anticipation for the upcoming release, I've prepared a demo--just in time for Steam Next Fest!

Please try it out and send in your comments and feedback (on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3343320/discussions/0/600771313357876663/]Steam forum[/url] or by [url=mailto:hello@ilovebigbits.com]email[/url]). I would love to hear from you so I can improve the game.

And if you like it, please be sure to wishlist so I can continue the journey towards release. Enjoy!
